verdict.rationale: Pulumi supports bulk operations in a few documented ways. It promotes using language loops to declare many resources at once (pulumi-gh-1). `pulumi preview --import-file` generates an import file covering every resource the program would create, enabling bulk adoption (pulumi-docs-21). Automation API lets software create, update, and destroy infrastructure programmatically (pulumi-docs-34). Community users report managing roughly 500-resource environments and cleaning up Kubernetes resources everywhere at once (pulumi-comm-9, pulumi-comm-5). However, there is no explicit bulk-operation feature, and much of this capability comes from the general IaC model rather than a dedicated capability. Missing for 10: a dedicated documented bulk/batch operation capability (e.g., bulk actions across stacks or resources in Pulumi Cloud or via the MCP server/Neo), first-party docs describing multi-stack bulk workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.
